about.title: THE PROJECT IN BRIEF

description.p1: Pokémon Stalactite is a French-language fangame developed using PSDK & Pokémon Studio, designed to offer fans a fresh and immersive experience in a semi-frozen world.
description.p2: This project is currently in development; some issues may occur...

news.title: RANDOM INFO
news.alpha_text: This is a private alpha version of the game. Please do not share it outside the development team.
news.screenshot_title: Feel free to screenshot the game!
news.screenshot_text: If you'd like to record the game or take a screenshot of a specific moment, feel free to share it with the community in the 📸・Media-only channel on Discord!
news.bugs_text: To report a bug—graphical, UI, gameplay behavior or a crash—please post it in the 🪲・Report-bug channel on Discord. Be as precise as possible!
news.contribute_title: How to contribute to the project?
news.contribute_text: If you enjoy the game and want to contribute, it's definitely possible! Applications are open, but WARNING: contributors are volunteers. You will be credited in-game, on the website, and with special roles on Discord. To open a ticket, use the 🎫・Ticket-question channel.
